conduct_outside_employment_001.evidence: Teachers who teach full-time in the regular day program shall not teach more than six (6) hours per week in the evening program except when working as an evening program administrator.

conduct_ethics_002.evidence: Each teacher is to be treated in a professional manner at all times. Teachers are to treat other employees of the system in a professional manner at all times.
conduct_ethics_002.coder_notes: Updated confidence to high as the evidence directly quotes Article 16 (Professional Responsibility), explicitly addressing professional conduct rules.

conduct_academic_freedom_007.evidence: Both parties agree that no legitimate issue of controversy in our society should be excluded from the classroom. However, all sides of controversial issues must be presented.
